outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: Fifty antenatal mothers with asymmetrical fetal growth restriction detected ultrasonographically around 30-32 weeks of gestation were treated with L-arginine and compared to a historical control group of fifty similar patients with non-ambulatory treatment.
finding: L-arginine was found to improve neonatal outcomes, including higher Apgar scores, lower incidence of respiratory distress syndrome and intraventricular hemorrhage, and lower admission to neonatal intensive care unit.
